tool_args.rationale: The nine paid rows vary current input and sink gradient while the other features remain fixed. A numerically fitted quadratic interaction surface is a compact smooth model that captures their joint curvature; no high-frequency oscillation signature is present. Prediction reads the supplied training rows through the execution harness.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its low-gradient point adds leverage on gradient dependence.
Already acquired, providing three additional points across the input-gradient domain.
Gradient changes at comparable input produce large output shifts, inconsistent with a current-input-only law.
Observed outputs vary non-monotonically with gradient and do not support a simple separable power law.
No observed gradient exceeds the noted high-gradient threshold region.
